title: Context Management and Compaction
brief: Two long migrations, each about 200 turns of roughly 300 tokens: 60,000 tokens of work through an 8,000-token window. The harness already compacts, but by truncating the oldest messages, and the oldest message is the task. Pick a strategy that lets at least 85% of runs finish correctly for $3.25 or less per task.

goals.label: At least 85% of runs finish correctly

hints: Open a failing transcript and find the first compaction. What did truncation drop?
Truncation throws away the oldest messages, and the oldest message is the task. Pick a strategy that keeps the task and shrinks the rest.
Set the Compactor strategy to summarize (or offload) and trigger it at about 0.7 of the window.
explain: Summarize and offload both keep the task and shrink the history, so the run survives 200 turns in an 8k window. Truncate and no compaction both lose the task, and the agent drifts.
